The other 37 accounts have had no orders or logins in over 18 months.

Could you confirm who requested the closures and whether the data quality agent re-checked ACC-5009, ACC-5023, and ACC-5038? Once I have that, I can close the 37 inactive accounts, or all 40 if the three are confirmed for closure.
